python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for Rural Electrification Administration 1961-1970 (in millions)
values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Sum = {sum(values)}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")

# Calculate Theil index
# T = (1/n) * Σ (y_i / ȳ) * ln(y_i / ȳ)
theil_sum = 0
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"\nTheil Index = {theil_index}")
print(f"Theil Index (rounded to 3 decimal places) = {round(theil_index, 3)}")
EOF
